reply.text: This is a symptom question about your back, so it's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, and I won't tell you whether to rest or move it. Get it looked at, and once they've cleared you, tell me what they said and I'll train around it. In the meantime I can keep the training side moving: if you want, we can look at what's been on your program this week so we know what to hold off on until you've been seen.
